notes.geometry: polygon: the alert's own polygon, drawn as published. zone_only: NWS names forecast zones and gives no polygon, so the alert is listed and never placed. rejected: the published polygon failed the checks and is not drawn.
notes.time: sent is when NWS issued the message; onset when the hazard is expected to begin; expires when the message expires; ends when the hazard is expected to end. Times are UTC.
notes.id: Each id is the World feed's event id for the same alert (nws:<NWS id>).
